findings.text: The State section still identifies `a03e8267` as the last measured revision and points to a scratch proof, although the final measurements use repository fixtures at `ee83eca7`. Fix: Name `ee83eca7` as the final measurement and identify `a03e8267` as the historical three-form comparison.

The summary attributes all ten retention proofs to the kind rules and data facts, but `runScriptStep_insert_ne_oneOf` covers INSERT with RETURNING or write rules and follows from the retained `runScriptStep_ne_oneOf_of_not_query`. Fix: Include the retained generic laws in the summary and identify the broader INSERT guarantee they preserve.

The record calls `a03e8267` the last revision with all three forms, although `e721eded`, the parent of the removal commit, still contains them. Fix: Label `a03e8267` as the last measured revision with all three forms in both the header and the milestone table.

The record says the commits after `c519a705` changed only docstrings, although those commits also updated the status file and added review records. Fix: Limit the statement to the measured Lean sources between `c519a705` and `ee83eca7`.

The timing section says later commits left the model unchanged, although `c519a705` removed three of the measured model modules. Fix: Bound the unchanged-model claim to the interval from `cdb0da41` through `a03e8267`.
